# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Cohere Opens 2.4B Vision Model for Edge Deployment](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cohere-north-micro-vision.html): North Micro Vision packages document and visual understanding into a 2.4B model with downloadable weights and an Apache 2.0 license.
- [Google Brings Sign-Language Dictation to Pixel Phones](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-sl2t-pixel.html): DeepMind’s SL2T model turns American Sign Language into text on Pixel 11, moving sign translation from research into daily phone use.
- [SpaceXAI Releases Grok 4.6 for Long-Running Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/grok-46-agents.html): Grok 4.6 targets coding and sustained agent work with a 500,000-token context window and pricing below several frontier rivals.
- [Alibaba Opens 2.4-Trillion-Parameter Qwen3.8 Weights](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/qwen38-weights-open.html): Alibaba has released its largest Qwen model’s weights, giving independent operators a frontier-scale foundation for coding and agents.
- [Twitch Makes Streamer Data Available for Amazon AI](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/twitch-ai-training-optout.html): Twitch now lets creators refuse generative-AI training, but its default setting leaves eligible channel content available to Amazon.
- [Anthropic Adds Watermarks to Claude-Generated Content](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-adds-content-watermarks.html): Claude is adding model-level marks to generated text and signed C2PA provenance to supported files worldwide as EU transparency rules take effect.
- [Gemini Reaches One Billion Monthly Active Users](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-crosses-billion-user-mark.html): Google’s AI assistant crossed one billion monthly users, matching ChatGPT and becoming its fastest-growing product to reach that scale.
- [Ant Group Releases Compact Ling 3.0 Tiny Model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ling-3-tiny-efficient-open-model.html): The 7.9B-parameter mixture-of-experts model targets economical local and agent deployment, activating only 1.3B parameters per token.
- [LTX-2.5 Brings Adaptive Compute to Open Video Models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ltx-releases-video-model-25.html): LTX’s new open-weight world model adds adaptive rendering, native 4K HDR output and stronger multi-shot control for local video production.
- [Mistral Opens Its AI Platform to Third-Party Models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/mistral-opens-platform-to-rivals.html): Mistral will host rival open models, beginning with Z.ai’s GLM-5.2, while adding regional inference and reserved European capacity.
- [Nvidia Releases Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/nvidia-releases-nemotron-lightning.html): The open 30B mixture-of-experts model activates 3B parameters per token and ships with training data, recipes and a new model router.
- [Solar Pro 4 Puts Korean Lab on Three Arena Boards](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/solar-pro-4-arena-debut.html): Upstage became the first Korean lab represented across Arena’s agent, web-development code and general text leaderboards.
- [Alibaba ships Wan CLI to put video gen in agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/alibaba-wan-cli-agent-video.html): Alibaba's Wan team released a command-line tool that lets coding agents call its image and video models programmatically, installed by pasting one command.
- [Claude lifts Riemann zeta lower bound to 67.2%](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-riemann-zeta-lower-bound.html): Anthropic says an unreleased research Claude raised the proven share of zeta zeros on the critical line from 41.6% to 67.2%, checked by outside experts.
- [Anthropic makes Sonnet 5's $2/$10 pricing permanent](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-sonnet-5-pricing-permanent.html): Anthropic scrapped the planned end of Claude Sonnet 5's introductory rate, locking $2 per million input and $10 per million output tokens past August 31.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [Cohere 开放 24 亿参数视觉模型，瞄准端侧部署](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cohere-north-micro-vision.html): North Micro Vision 以 24 亿参数承载文档和视觉理解能力，开放权重并采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。
- [谷歌将手语输入带到 Pixel 11，首发支持美式手语](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-sl2t-pixel.html): DeepMind 的 SL2T 模型进入 Gboard 与实时转写，让 Pixel 11 用户可直接用美式手语输入英文。
- [SpaceXAI 发布 Grok 4.6，主攻长程智能体任务](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/grok-46-agents.html): Grok 4.6 以 50 万 token 上下文、原生工具调用和更低定价切入编程及长时间运行的智能体工作流。
- [阿里开放 Qwen3.8 旗舰模型权重，参数达 2.4 万亿](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/qwen38-weights-open.html): 阿里正式开放 Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B 权重，为代码与长程智能体提供可独立部署的超大规模基础模型。
- [Twitch 开放 AI 训练退出选项，但默认仍允许使用](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/twitch-ai-training-optout.html): Twitch 允许主播拒绝亚马逊使用频道内容训练生成式 AI，但默认设置仍将符合条件的数据纳入训练范围。
- [Anthropic 为 Claude 文本与文件加入隐形标记](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-adds-content-watermarks.html): 随着欧盟透明度规则生效，Claude 开始在全球范围为生成文本加入模型级隐形水印，并为受支持文件写入经过签名的 C2PA 来源凭证。
- [Gemini 月活突破 10 亿，追平 ChatGPT](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-crosses-billion-user-mark.html): Gemini 应用月活跃用户突破 10 亿，追平 ChatGPT，并成为谷歌历史上最快达到这一规模的产品。
- [蚂蚁发布稀疏小模型 Ling 3.0 Tiny](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ling-3-tiny-efficient-open-model.html): Ling 3.0 Tiny 总参数量为 79 亿、每个 token 仅激活 13 亿参数，瞄准低成本本地部署与高频智能体任务。
- [LTX-2.5 开放权重，用自适应算力提升视频质量](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ltx-releases-video-model-25.html): 新一代开放权重视频世界模型引入动态渲染机制，并支持原生 4K HDR、音画同步和更强的多镜头控制。
- [Mistral 平台接入第三方模型，首发 GLM-5.2](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/mistral-opens-platform-to-rivals.html): Mistral 将从智谱 GLM-5.2 开始托管第三方开放模型，同时推出欧美区域推理节点和欧洲优先算力。
- [英伟达发布 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 智能体模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/nvidia-releases-nemotron-lightning.html): 这款 300 亿参数 MoE 模型每次仅激活约 30 亿参数，并同步开放权重、训练数据、配方与模型路由工具。
- [Solar Pro 4 同时登上 Arena 三类榜单](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/solar-pro-4-arena-debut.html): Upstage 成为首家同时进入 Arena 智能体、网页开发代码和通用文本榜单的韩国实验室。
- [阿里推出 Wan CLI，把视频生成塞进智能体工作流](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/alibaba-wan-cli-agent-video.html): 阿里通义万相发布命令行工具 Wan CLI，智能体可直接以编程方式调用其图像与视频模型，安装只需粘贴一条命令。
- [Claude 把黎曼 ζ 零点下界从 41.6% 提到 67.2%](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-riemann-zeta-lower-bound.html): Anthropic 称一个未发布的研究版 Claude 将临界线上 ζ 函数零点占比的已证下界提高到 67.2%，并已获外部专家审读。
- [Anthropic 把 Sonnet 5 的 2/10 美元优惠价永久化](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-sonnet-5-pricing-permanent.html): Anthropic 取消 Claude Sonnet 5 优惠价的截止日期，每百万输入 2 美元、输出 10 美元的定价在 8 月 31 日后继续沿用。

- [全部简报（中文）](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/): Chinese edition

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-08-13.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
